issues.t: Engine knock, oil loss and engine failure
issues.sym: Knocking from the engine, the oil light coming on, or the engine suddenly losing power and stopping. Some owners found the oil had run low before it failed, and a few had a connecting rod break through the oil pan. Most reports are around 115,000-140,000 miles.
issues.why: Connecting rod bearings wear out and the engine seizes, often after oil consumption or a slow leak lets the level drop. Engine trouble is the top complaint category for the 2015 and 2016 model years, and owners of later vans report the same pattern.
issues.next: Check the oil every few fill-ups and top it up. If you hear a knock or the oil light flickers, stop driving and have it checked. Ask a Kia dealer to check your VIN for any engine campaign or extended coverage before paying for an engine.

issues.t: Front lower control arms rust and break (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front end over bumps, the van pulling to one side, or in the worst case a front wheel collapsing out of position.
issues.why: In road-salt states the front lower control arms can corrode until they crack. Recalls 13V550000 and 16V387000 cover 2006-2012 Sedonas sold or registered in salt-belt states and D.C.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer check your VIN; the control arms are inspected and replaced for free. If you hear new clunks from the front, get it inspected before driving at speed.

issues.t: ABS module can short and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: An ABS warning light, a burning smell or smoke from the engine compartment, sometimes with the van parked and off.
issues.why: Moisture can get into the anti-lock brake module and short its circuit board, which can start a fire. Recall 20V088000 covers 2006-2010 Sedona.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and leave the hood closed. Call 911 from a safe spot, even if you can't see flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Park outside until a Kia dealer completes the free recall repair. If you see the ABS light or smell burning, don't park it in a garage.

issues.t: Alternator fails after oil leak soaks it
issues.sym: The battery light comes on, lights dim, the van won't restart, or you smell burning oil. You may see oil on the alternator or the front of the engine.
issues.why: Oil leaking from engine gaskets above the alternator drips onto it and ruins it. Owners report this as the top problem on the 2007 Sedona, around 90,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the charging system tested. When replacing the alternator, also fix the oil leak above it, or the new one will fail the same way.

issues.t: Transmission shudder or harsh shifting
issues.sym: A shudder during light-throttle upshifts, harsh or jerky downshifts, a delay going from Park to Drive, slipping under load, or a check engine light.
issues.why: The torque converter lock-up clutch can wear early and valve body solenoids can stick. 2015-2018 vans use a 6-speed automatic and 2019-2021 vans an 8-speed; both get transmission software updates from Kia.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Kia dealer whether a transmission software update applies to your VIN. Check the fluid condition. Get a diagnosis before agreeing to a full replacement, since a software update or torque converter may fix it.

issues.t: Power sliding doors stop working
issues.sym: A power sliding door won't open or close on its own, stops partway, reverses, or makes grinding noises.
issues.why: The door motors, cables, latches and wiring that run through the door track wear out with daily use. Owners report it as a top problem on the 2007 Sedona at about 100,000 miles.
issues.next: Clean and lubricate the door track and check for objects jammed in it. If it still fails, have a shop test the motor, cable and latch before replacing the whole drive unit.

issues.t: Hood can open while driving (recall)
issues.sym: The hood isn't held by the safety catch when the main latch releases, so it could fly up at speed.
issues.why: The secondary hood latch can stick in the open position. Recall 16V389000 covers 2006-2014 Sedonas built June 2005 to April 2014.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to replace or clean and lube the latch for free. Until then, check that the hood is fully closed before each drive.

issues.t: Brake lights stay on or won't light (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights stuck on or not working, cruise control not cancelling, push-button start problems, or the shifter coming out of Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: The brake light switch can fail. Recall 09V130000 covers 2006-2007 Sedonas and recall 13V114000 covers 2007-2011 Sedonas.
issues.next: Have someone check your brake lights. Ask a Kia dealer to confirm the free switch replacement was done for your VIN.

issues.t: Brake light switch wiring can chafe (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights not working, the engine stalling, or the van not starting.
issues.why: The wiring to the brake light switch can rub against the steering column joint and wear through. Recall 06V349000 covers the 2006 Sedona.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to confirm the free wiring repair has been done.

issues.t: Rear brake hoses can rub and break (recall)
issues.sym: Brake fluid leaking near a rear wheel, a soft pedal or the brake warning light.
issues.why: The rear caliper brake hoses can touch suspension parts and wear through, letting brake fluid out. Recall 06V265000 covers the 2006 Sedona.
issues.next: If the brake pedal sinks, feels soft or goes closer to the floor, or a red brake warning comes on, slow down gently, use a lower gear, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on: call for a tow. If the pedal is soft or fluid is leaking, don't drive it. Ask a Kia dealer to confirm the free hose repair was done.

issues.t: Fuel rail can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A strong gasoline smell, especially after the engine is warm, or fuel dripping on top of the engine.
issues.why: Engine heat can crack the fuel rail that feeds the injectors, creating a fire risk. Recall 20V101000 covers 2011-2012 Sedona; owners report it as the top 2011 problem at around 100,000 miles.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, stop driving and have it towed. Ask a Kia dealer to replace the fuel rail under the recall for free.

issues.t: Airbag control unit may short in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. Sometimes the airbag light comes on.
issues.why: The airbag control unit can short circuit during a crash, so the front airbags and seat belt pretensioners may not deploy. Recall 18V363000 covers 2011-2012 Sedona.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer confirm the free repair was done for your VIN.

issues.t: Easy to steal: no engine immobilizer on key-start vans
issues.sym: Damage to the steering column cover or ignition, or the van is stolen. This applies to Sedonas with a regular metal key rather than push-button start.
issues.why: Key-start Sedonas from these years were built without an engine immobilizer, so thieves can start them by breaking the ignition cylinder. Kia offers a software update that adds an ignition kill. It may be covered.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to install the anti-theft software update. It may be covered. Use a steering wheel lock in the meantime, and check your insurance coverage.

issues.t: Throttle cable can stick (recall)
issues.sym: The engine doesn't drop back to idle when you lift off the gas, especially in freezing weather.
issues.why: The throttle cable could be twisted out of place at the factory (recall 05V013000), and water on the cable could freeze and make it stick (recall 05V329000).
issues.next: If the engine stays revved, shift to Neutral, brake to a stop and turn the engine off. Ask a Kia dealer to confirm both recalls were done.

issues.t: Rear wheel bearings damaged by water (recall)
issues.sym: A growling or humming noise from the rear that rises with speed, or looseness in a rear wheel.
issues.why: Moisture collecting behind the rear hub caps can damage the outer wheel bearing, which could fail suddenly. Recall 05V232000 replaces the hub caps and damaged bearings or hubs.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer confirm the recall was done. A loud or growing bearing noise needs to be checked right away.

issues.t: ABS programming lengthens low-speed stops (recall)
issues.sym: The van takes longer than expected to stop at low speeds, below about 25 mph.
issues.why: A programming error in the anti-lock brake module reduced braking at low speed. Recall 03V158000 reprograms the module.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to confirm the free reprogramming was done.

issues.t: Rear seat belt anchor bolts and seat strikers (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs; the parts may not hold properly in a crash.
issues.why: Second- and third-row seat belt buckle anchor bolts didn't meet federal standards (recall 03V017000), and some second- and third-row seat strikers were heat-treated wrongly and could break (recall 03V135000).
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer confirm both recalls were completed for your VIN.

issues.t: Alternator failure
issues.sym: Battery warning light, dim lights, a dead battery or the van stalling. Reports average about 60,000 miles.
issues.why: The alternator wears out early on this model year and is the top owner complaint for 2002, with high repair bills because of how it's mounted.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging output tested before replacing parts. Get a quote for a quality remanufactured alternator.

issues.t: Brake noise and fast brake wear
issues.sym: Grinding, squealing or pulsing when you brake. Reports average around 90,000 miles.
issues.why: This heavy van is hard on its brakes, and pads and rotors wear and warp sooner than on a car. Brakes are among the top complaint categories for the 2004 Sedona.
issues.next: Have the pads and rotors measured. Replace pads before they reach metal to avoid ruining the rotors.

issues.t: Rear heater coolant lines rust and leak
issues.sym: Coolant puddles under the middle of the van, a sweet smell, the coolant level dropping, or the temperature gauge rising.
issues.why: Metal coolant pipes that run under the van to the rear heater rust from road salt and moisture and eventually leak.
issues.next: Check under the van for green or pink fluid. Keep coolant topped up and replace rusted lines before they burst, as a sudden coolant loss can overheat the engine.

issues.t: Steering suddenly stiff or binding
issues.sym: The steering wheel suddenly becomes very hard to turn or feels like it locks up while driving.
issues.why: Owners report power steering faults on this model year, which can come from a failing pump, low fluid from a leak, or a worn steering rack.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Check the power steering fluid level and look for leaks. If the steering binds while driving, have it inspected before using the van again.

issues.t: Power sliding door may not reverse when blocked (recall)
issues.sym: The power sliding door keeps closing on an arm, a hand or an object instead of reversing.
issues.why: The door's pinch protection may not detect an obstruction. Recall 18V338000 covers 2015-2018 Sedonas with power sliding doors and updates the system.
issues.next: Keep kids clear of the doors and have a Kia dealer do the free recall repair.

issues.t: Passenger seat occupant sensor wiring breaks (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light acts up or the airbag warning light comes on.
issues.why: On Sedonas with a manually adjusted front passenger seat, the occupant detection wiring under the seat can break, which could keep the passenger airbag from working correctly. Recall 19V109000.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer confirm the free repair. Children should ride in the back.

issues.t: Turn signal flashes the wrong direction (recall)
issues.sym: You signal one way and the opposite turn signal blinks.
issues.why: Software in the smart junction box can misread the turn signal stalk. Recall 21V725000 updates the software.
issues.next: Watch the dash arrows when signaling and ask a Kia dealer for the free software update.

issues.t: Van may roll away after shifting to Park (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter shows Park but the van can still move, or the shifter doesn't feel like it locks into position.
issues.why: Parts in the shift lever may not lock properly. Recall 22V612000 covers some 2016 Sedonas.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake until the free recall repair is done.

issues.t: Airbag control unit cover can damage the circuit (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on, though there may be no warning.
issues.why: The cover of the airbag control unit can press on a memory chip and damage the circuit, so the airbags might not deploy. Recall 22V031000.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer confirm the free repair was done for your VIN.

issues.t: Second-row middle seat belt buckle on wrong side (recall)
issues.sym: On 8-passenger vans, the second-row middle passenger can't buckle the 3-point belt properly.
issues.why: The buckle may have been installed on the wrong side of the seat at the factory. Recall 19V207000.
issues.next: Don't seat anyone in that position until a Kia dealer fixes it for free.

issues.t: Loose alternator cable nut can cause a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Battery light, flickering electrical items, or a burning smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: The nut on the alternator's main battery cable may not have been tightened at the factory. If it loosens, electrical arcing could start a fire. Recall 20V399000.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and leave the hood closed. Call 911 from a safe spot, even if you can't see flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Have a Kia dealer inspect and tighten the nut for free.

issues.t: Heater weak in cold weather
issues.sym: The cabin, especially the rear, never gets truly warm on cold days.
issues.why: Owners report weak heat on this model year. Common causes are low coolant, air trapped in the cooling system, a stuck thermostat or a blend door that isn't moving fully to hot.
issues.next: Check the coolant level when cold. Have a shop check the thermostat and the heater blend door operation; it's a warranty item on newer vans.

issues.t: Shifter stuck in Park
issues.sym: The shifter won't move out of Park even with your foot on the brake.
issues.why: The shift interlock that releases Park depends on the brake light switch and a small solenoid, and either can fail.
issues.next: Check whether the brake lights work. Use the shift-lock override slot near the shifter to get moving, then have the switch and interlock checked.

issues.t: Battery goes dead
issues.sym: The van won't start after sitting, sometimes at very low mileage.
issues.why: Owners report dead batteries on the 2015 Sedona. A weak battery or something draining power with the van off, such as a module that doesn't go to sleep, is usually the cause.
issues.next: Have the battery load-tested and a parasitic draw test done. Ask a dealer about software updates if the drain comes back.
